rationale: Region eligibility describes one function, but the prior VM slice executed across calls. Core now stops the opted-in slice before charging or executing the first operation of another function. corrections: The original verified ProjectCall fixture returned from the entire caller instead of stopping at the callee; the changed boundary assertion failed on the old implementation. The static regression covers requested budgets 0/1/10, an untouched callee cursor and registers, retained frames and exact consumed budget. The ProjectCall regression retains the actual callable program lease and resumes the callee plus caller in the owning VM. Final codegen is 17/17 PASS.
